gateway.title: Gateway

bridge.title: Remote Bridge
bridge.desc: Manage the WebSocket bridge service so external clients can connect to and control this ClawX-Cat / OpenClaw runtime.
bridge.enabledDesc: Start the bridge service and allow remote clients to connect with a token.
bridge.allowRemoteDesc: When enabled, listen on an external address; otherwise only listen on the local loopback address.
bridge.httpDesc: Adds an HTTP + SSE bridge entry that mirrors the existing WebSocket Bridge capabilities.
bridge.httpEnabledDesc: Start the dedicated HTTP bridge service and protect it with a token.
bridge.invalidPort: Please enter a valid bridge port
bridge.discoveryDesc: Let apps on the same LAN discover this device and bridge entrypoint via UDP broadcast.
bridge.discoveryEnabledDesc: When enabled, ClawX automatically allows LAN devices to discover and connect to this device.
bridge.relayDesc: Let this device connect outward to a cloud relay so mobile apps can reach ClawX outside the local network.
bridge.relayEnabledDesc: When enabled, the bridge opens an outbound WebSocket connection to the configured cloud relay.

startup.title: Startup Parameters
startup.desc: Control Gateway startup policy. Linux defaults to lightweight startup.
startup.linuxDefault: Current platform is Linux: Auto defaults to server-lite.
startup.nonLinuxDefault: Current platform is non-Linux: Auto defaults to full.
startup.extraArgsHelp: Appended after `openclaw gateway`; env vars and CLI args can override this value.

gateway.proxyDesc: Route Electron and Gateway traffic through your local proxy client.
gateway.proxyServerHelp: The default proxy for all requests. Bare host:port values default to HTTP.
gateway.proxyHttpServerHelp: Advanced override for HTTP requests. Leave blank to use Proxy Server.
gateway.proxyHttpsServerHelp: Advanced override for HTTPS requests. Leave blank to use Proxy Server.
gateway.proxyAllServerHelp: Advanced fallback for SOCKS-capable clients and protocols such as Telegram. Leave blank to use Proxy Server.
gateway.proxyBypassHelp: Semicolon, comma, or newline separated hosts that should connect directly.
gateway.proxyRestartNote: Saving reapplies Electron networking and restarts the Gateway immediately. Regular Gateway restarts keep existing Telegram channel proxy values when proxy is disabled; save while disabled to clear them.
